items.quote: Therefore Sarah laughed within herself, saying, After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?
items.claim: Sarah laughed within herself at the prospect of bearing pleasure in old age despite her husband's old age

items.quote: And the LORD said unto Abraham, Wherefore did Sarah laugh, saying, Shall I of a surety bear a child, which am old?
items.claim: The LORD asked Abraham why Sarah laughed about bearing a child while old

items.quote: Is any thing too hard for the LORD?
items.claim: Nothing is too hard for the LORD

items.quote: At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.
items.claim: God promises to return at an appointed time and grant Sarah a son
items.mechanism: according to the time of life
